correctness.rationale: Convolution with the centered three-frequency kernel gives the normalized absolute kernel sum as the exact ℓ∞ operator norm by the sign extremizer; finite-dimensional duality gives the same ℓ1 norm. The kernel is negative exactly for integer samples N/3<k<2N/3. Summing the cosine over that consecutive interval yields the three displayed formulas according to N mod 3. Fresh direct evaluation for every N from 3 through 500 agrees with the closed form to at most 6.7×10⁻16; this numerical replay is corroborative, while the finite cosine-sum derivation proves all N.
